issues.title: Research: how agents pay for API calls on NEAR today
issues.body: Collect verifiable facts for the brief: the x402 exact scheme on NEAR (NEP-366 delegate settlement), what a merchant runs (resource server + facilitator), what a paying agent needs, and current limits. Cite sources and on-chain evidence. Deliver notes at `research/agent-payments.md`.

issues.title: Write: one-page brief on agent payments on NEAR
issues.body: Turn the research notes into a one-page brief for Acme's product team at `briefs/agent-payments.md`. Plain language, one diagram at most, every claim traceable to the research notes.

issues.title: Review: accept the agent payments brief
issues.body: Human review of `briefs/agent-payments.md` against the engagement brief. Either request changes in a comment or post a handoff accepting the brief.
